nodes.label: graphify query-before-grep rule
nodes.rationale: graphify-out/graph.json queries return a scoped subgraph that is much smaller than raw grep or GRAPH_REPORT.md, so agents must query the graph before exploring source files.

nodes.label: GUI-binary false-green trap (use GODOT_EXE_CONSOLE)
nodes.rationale: Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe is a WINDOWS_GUI-subsystem PE that detaches under PowerShell's &, silently no-ops and reports success; headless runs must use the console twin derived by godot_path.bat.

nodes.label: gdUnit false-green detection (0-byte logs, exit 103/105)
nodes.rationale: A GUI-binary headless run detaches and writes nothing while reporting success (8 ms 'pass', 0-byte _gdunit.txt), so every run must be confirmed by file size and by exit codes before it is believed.

nodes.label: ULTRADRIVE_PERF_MODE two-mode perf gate
nodes.rationale: The 16.7 ms PerfBench.CONTRACT_FRAME_BUDGET_MS value is never loosened - only the gate self-selects (reference vs relative mode from control_ms). Stated cost: in relative mode a regression that slows every preset equally is undetectable.

nodes.label: Perf gate reference/relative modes (GDUnit gate doc)
nodes.norm_label: perf gate reference/relative modes (gdunit gate doc)
nodes.rationale: The gate self-selects from the run's own control_ms so the absolute 16.7 ms contract is enforced only when the box proved it can hold 60 Hz; the honest tradeoff is that relative mode cannot detect an equal-slowdown regression.

nodes.label: Self-selecting perf gate (reference/relative) - handoff
nodes.rationale: CONTRACT_FRAME_BUDGET_MS stays 16.7 while the enforcing gate picks reference or relative mode from control_ms, making the suite machine-portable for CI; relative mode trades away detection of uniform regressions.

nodes.label: No-Rubber-Band Rival AI
nodes.rationale: Physics-honest rivals with no catch-up assist on the player - clean AI shipped and test-covered as the marketing differentiator against Drivatars.

nodes.label: Drivatar Personality Lesson
nodes.rationale: Players race people - nameable, persistent rival personalities are the cheap deepening of already-shipped AI, learned from recurring 'I miss running Drivatar [handle]' posts.

nodes.label: GT-Original Fictional Track Legacy Roster
nodes.rationale: Polyphony's own designs mostly returning from GT1-GT4 remastered - familiarity plus one twist, rather than only adding real circuits.

nodes.label: One Open World vs 121 Layouts (Design Choice)
nodes.norm_label: one open world vs 121 layouts (design choice)
nodes.rationale: One distinctive handcrafted open world versus GT7's 121 layouts is a design choice, not a defect; give the single world more remembered places rather than more maps.

nodes.label: WHEEL_GROUPS Wheel-Split Blocker
nodes.rationale: Meshy emits a single whole-car mesh with no per-corner wheel nodes, so every model needs the existing Blender-MCP normalization pass (nose +Z, X-axle, named wheel nodes).

nodes.label: Deterministic Seeded World Generation (MASTER_SEED)
nodes.rationale: One master seed plus per-region seed hashing makes the whole world a pure function of one number, so saves, CI and toggles stay consistent.

nodes.label: Cheap Ugly-Win Gap Framework
nodes.rationale: Every gap is graded by closability for a small team: cheap ugly-wins are ordered first, structural gaps (roster count, online, RT fidelity) are declared honestly as different-product.

nodes.label: D:-drive-only filesystem hygiene rule
nodes.rationale: User hard rule (2026-10-04): never use the C: drive at all; every headless/parallel run must override APPDATA to an absolute path under the project root so saves, logs and gdUnit temp land on D:.

nodes.label: Per-shard APPDATA user:// isolation
nodes.rationale: Godot resolves user:// from APPDATA with no canonicalization, so an absolute per-child APPDATA both removes save-slot contention between 13 suites and keeps every byte off C:.

nodes.label: Event Clustering by Driving Culture
nodes.rationale: Events and social anchors are placed where each driving culture gathers - drifters on mountain passes, street racers on elevated highways, drag culture at staging lanes - rather than on a grid.

nodes.label: Fog-of-War Route Discovery
nodes.rationale: First Horizon to hide the map at start: regions, roads and POIs reveal only by driving through them, turning discovery into a core loop and free fast travel into its reward.

nodes.norm_label: cockpit as a reward view (design rule)
nodes.rationale: Cockpit is a feature/reward view, never the onboarding default - chase wins on spatial awareness and track-ahead readability; VR flips this by locking to cockpit/bonnet.

nodes.rationale: Single biggest cockpit blocker: exterior-only GLBs give the camera a hollow shell - no dash, pillars or interior node exists in player_car.tscn/CarBody.

nodes.label: VehiclePhysics input_override_active Flag
nodes.rationale: VehiclePhysics previously treated input_override == Vector2.ZERO as 'no override', so an AI coasting would silently fall back to player InputManager. An explicit active flag lets an AI's Vector2.ZERO (coast) be distinguished from no-override; while active, handbrake is forced off and the drivetrain is forced AUTO so a MANUAL setting cannot lock AI cars in first gear.

nodes.label: OpponentFleet Spawn Factory
nodes.rationale: build_grid picks the nearest CLOSED road chain from road_network.get_roads(), re-samples it to uniform 6 m waypoints, spawns opponents staggered (i+1)*4 waypoints ahead with alternating +/-2.6 m lane offsets, and returns [player, ai1, ...] in exactly the Array type RaceManager.start_race consumes.

nodes.label: Synthetic Ring Scene + AI Driving Tests
nodes.norm_label: synthetic ring scene + ai driving tests
nodes.rationale: Determinism: no RNG anywhere in the AI path, tests seed fixed (seed(12345)), assert inequalities/monotonic progress rather than exact values, and drive under GDUnit scene_runner().simulate_frames() at 120 Hz physics.

nodes.label: glTF 2.0 (.glb) Export Workflow
nodes.rationale: 1 Blender unit = 1 meter, apply scale before export; export +Y Up with UVs/normals/tangents and triangulate N-gons. Godot auto-generates collision at import via Generate->Physics, with -col/-noimp/-lod suffixes controlling it; never edit an imported scene directly, make an Inherited Scene.

nodes.label: uv Package Runner Toolchain
nodes.rationale: uv is the package runner the Blender-MCP server uses; it also sidesteps the broken Microsoft Store Python stub because its tool env installs its own Python.

nodes.label: D-Drive-Only Install Constraint
nodes.rationale: The user explicitly requires any installs go on D:\ only; never write to C:\Program Files for new tooling, use portable/manual installs where the default installer targets C:. Use BLENDER install-dir override, D:\Tools\uv, UV_TOOL_DIR/UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR, and a portable Blender zip.

nodes.label: Unreal Engine Deferral Decision
nodes.rationale: UE is free but needs an Epic account, ~100+ GB disk, and a DX11/12 GPU, and nothing it builds runs in Godot natively; its only role would be a second asset/level authoring tool, credibly covered by Blender at a fraction of the footprint. Recommended: skip Unreal unless Nanite/Lumen scale or collaborator UE assets are needed, then glTF-through-Blender remains the interop bridge.

nodes.label: AudioRouting Autoload (Music/Ambience/SFX buses + WindBed)
nodes.rationale: Optional menu music is explicitly deferred: the Music bus exists and is Master-routed but no music source is added; ambience is a single quiet always-on wind bed (deliberately not per-scene to keep scope tight).

nodes.label: Skid + Wind Intensity/Volume Mapping
nodes.rationale: get_drive_info() has no slip key, so skid is a documented proxy computed in CarAudio from get_steer_angle() + get_speed_kmh() + InputManager.is_handbrake(); no physics change.

nodes.label: Synth-Only Audio Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Keep the procedural engine loop and generate all PCM at runtime with zero new binary assets (seeded RandomNumberGenerator, 16-bit mono AudioStreamWAV, LOOP_FORWARD). The engine loop must stay byte-compatible (identical arithmetic), so extraction to statics is allowed but value changes are not.
